tenderSchedule.title: Construction of Public and Community Toilet Facilities at Various Locations within the Jurisdiction of Raichur City Corporation, including Allied Civil, Sanitary, Water Supply, Electrical and Other Necessary Works, Complete in All Respects.(PACKAGE-1)
tenderSchedule.description: The work comprises construction of Public Toilets at SC Burial Ground, Yeramarus, Ashok Nagar and Satyanath Colony (Ward No.13), Manik Nagar (Ward No.18), Yakkasapura, Hosur and Yeramarus STPs, GHPS, Rampur (Ward No.35), Government School, Yeramarus, Rampur and Chicksugur WTPs, Auto Nagar (Ward No.32), GHPS/KPS, Station Bazar (Ward No.02), GUHPS, Mangalwarpete (Ward No.14), and Haya GUHPS. The work also comprises construction of Community Toilets near OHT, Yeramarus, Yeramarus Danda, near Agasekatte beside UGD Tank, Amaravathi Pothal, Ward No.33, Amaravathi Pothal, Parakota (Ward No.12), New Ashraya Colony, Survey No.558, Railway Under Bridge, Chunna Batte Road (Ward No.32), Jambegida, Hosur (Ward No.06), Veerabhadreshwara Temple (Ward No.09), and Nomadic Community Area (Ward No.23).The scope includes all allied civil, sanitary, water supply, drainage, electrical, plumbing, fixtures, finishing and other necessary works, including testing and commissioning, complete in all respects as per the approved estimate, technical specifications and instructions of the Engineer-in-Charge.(PACKAGE-1)

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidders shall strictly upload only the documents required under the tender conditions. No additional, irrelevant or unsolicited documents shall be uploaded.

technicalCriterionList.description: Owning the following key and critical equipment for this work (xxxx, xxxx, xxxx)
Liquid assets and /or availability of credit facilities of no less than Rs. xxxxxx Lakhs (estimated cash flow for 3 months of peak construction period)
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded

Achieved, in at least two financial years, a minimum annual financial turnover of Rs. 600.00 lakh (Rupees Six Crore only) in civil engineering construction works. The tenderer shall submit a year-wise financial turnover certificate certified by a practising Chartered Accountant, bearing a valid UDIN, along with supporting audited financial statements.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

technicalCriterionList.description: Satisfactorily completed, as a prime contractor, at least one similar work of value not less than Rs.150.00 lakh (Rupees One Crore Fifty Lakh only). Similar works shall mean construction of community toilets, public toilet complexes, public buildings, institutional buildings or other comparable building works involving civil construction and associated water supply, plumbing and sanitary installations.

The tenderer shall demonstrate availability of liquid assets and/or credit facilities of not less than Rs.90.00 lakh (Rupees Ninety Lakh only), from nationalized / scheduled banks for meeting the fund requirement etc., the Bankers certificate should be submitted as per below format.
Valid KPWD Class-I (Civil) Contractor License Registration

Executed during any one year (continuous period of 12 months), the following minimum quantities 1.Earthwork excavation, including ordinary soil and hard rock-462.96 Cum, 2.Concrete work, including PCC and RCC- 174.33 Cum,3. Structural steel work tubular trusses and built-up steel sections-5.441 MT,4. TMT reinforcement steel work-6.336 MT, 5.Solid concrete block / equivalent masonry wall work-2416.2 Sqm, 6.Cement plastering work-4619.96 Sqm and 7.Laying ceramic/glazed tiles, including flooring, skirting and dadoing-1673.34 Sqm

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Work Done Certificate with minimum quantities

The tenderer shall possess valid contractor registration of the appropriate class, shall not be under any applicable declaration of ineligibility, blacklisted by any public authorities or debarment, and shall comply with all other requirements of the applicable Karnataka Standard Tender Document.
Valid KPWD Class-I Civil Contractor License Registration

To qualify for a package of contracts made up of this and other contracts for which tenders are invited in this IFT, the Tenderer must demonstrate having experience and resources to meet the aggregate of the qualifying criteria for the individual contracts.
Sub contractors experience and resources shall not be taken into account in determining the Tenderers compliance with the qualifying criteria except to the extent stated in 3.2 d and e above.
